scope: Only the roles named in the requirements:Guest, Customer (base role), Seller and Bidder. A Customer can act as both Seller and Bidder.

status_legend.in_progress: The feature is the current active task.
status_legend.blocked: Work cannot continue until a documented blocker is resolved.
status_legend.passing: Required verification has passed and evidence is recorded.

roles.customer: Any signed-in user. Can be a seller, a bidder, or both.
roles.seller: A customer who creates and manages auctions.
roles.bidder: A customer who places bids and posts messages on auctions.

features.title: Login
features.user_visible_behavior: A customer can log in with valid credentials and is rejected with an error message on invalid credentials.
verification: Open the login page.
Submit a valid username/email and password.
Verify the customer is redirected to their home/dashboard and is shown as logged in.
Log out, then submit a wrong password.
Verify an error message is shown and no session is created.
evidence: 2026-10-16 be/tests/auth.login.test.ts: 6/6 vitest pass (login by username + email, wrong password 401 with no Set-Cookie, unknown user same message, field validation, logout clears session)
2026-10-16 e2e/cust-001-login.spec.ts: Playwright pass (login -> /dashboard shows alice; logout; wrong password shows alert, /api/auth/me 401)
features.notes: Seeded accounts alice/bob/carol, password Password123! (be/prisma/seed.ts). Session = httpOnly JWT cookie.

features.title: Register
features.user_visible_behavior: New user can create new account with validation input infos
verification: Open register page
Input all fields with invalid info and wait for validation
Input valid information to all fields required, hit create new user , then waiting success notification
Check API send email to user mail
evidence: 2026-10-16 be/tests/auth.register.test.ts 4/4 vitest pass (per-field validation, password confirmation, duplicate email/username 409, account created + confirmation mail in outbox + token verifies once)

2026-10-16 e2e/guest-001-register.spec.ts Playwright pass (invalid inputs show 6 field errors, duplicate username error, success toast, /api/dev/outbox has confirmation mail, link confirms email, new user logs in)
features.notes: Email: SMTP when SMTP_HOST set, otherwise dev outbox (GET /api/dev/outbox, non-production only). New users are status pending until the link is confirmed; login is allowed while pending.

features.title: Manage profile
features.user_visible_behavior: A logged-in customer can view and edit their profile details (e.g. name, email, phone, address) and the changes are saved.
verification: Log in and open the profile page.
Verify current profile details are displayed.
Edit one or more fields and save.
Reload the page and verify the new values persist.
Submit an invalid value (e.g. malformed email) and verify a validation error is shown.
evidence: 2026-10-16 be/tests/profile.test.ts 3/3 vitest pass (auth required, edit persists, malformed email 400, duplicate email 409)
2026-10-16 e2e/cust-002-profile.spec.ts Playwright pass (details shown, edit+save toast, reload persists, malformed email shows error and is not saved)

features.title: Change password
features.user_visible_behavior: A logged-in customer can change their password by providing the current password and a new one.
verification: Log in and open the change password page.
Enter a wrong current password and verify the change is rejected.
Enter the correct current password and a new password (with confirmation) and submit.
Log out and verify login fails with the old password.
Verify login succeeds with the new password.
evidence: 2026-10-16 be/tests/password.change.test.ts 3/3 vitest pass (wrong current 400, validation, change -> old login 401 / new login 200)
2026-10-16 e2e/cust-003-change-password.spec.ts Playwright pass (wrong current rejected, change toast, old password login fails, new succeeds)

features.title: Forget password
features.user_visible_behavior: A customer who forgot their password can request a reset and set a new password without logging in.
verification: Open the login page and click 'Forgot password'.
Submit the registered email/username.
Verify a reset link/token is issued (email or logged output in dev).
Use the reset link/token to set a new password.
Verify login succeeds with the new password and the reset token cannot be reused.
Submit an unknown email and verify no account information is leaked.
evidence: 2026-10-16 be/tests/password.reset.test.ts 3/3 vitest pass (token mailed, reset works once, older link invalidated, unknown email gets identical response and no mail)
2026-10-16 e2e/cust-004-forgot-password.spec.ts Playwright pass (forgot link -> generic message -> mailed link -> new password -> old fails/new works -> reuse rejected -> unknown email no mail)
features.notes: Delivery: email via mailer (SMTP if SMTP_HOST set, else dev outbox + console log). Token sha256-hashed in DB, 1h TTL, single use, newest request invalidates older links.

features.title: Manage your credit account
features.user_visible_behavior: A customer can view their credit balance and transaction history, and top up / withdraw credit.
verification: Log in and open the credit account page.
Verify current balance and transaction history are displayed.
Top up a valid amount and verify the balance increases and a transaction is recorded.
Attempt to withdraw more than the available balance and verify it is rejected.
Withdraw a valid amount and verify the balance decreases and a transaction is recorded.
features.notes: Needed before bidding so bids can be checked against available credit.

features.title: Create new auction
features.user_visible_behavior: A seller can create an auction with item details, starting price, and start/end time, and it becomes visible to bidders.
verification: Log in and open the create auction page.
Fill in item name, description, starting price, minimum increment, start time and end time.
Submit and verify the auction appears in the seller's auction list.
Log in as a different customer and verify the auction is visible.
Submit invalid data (negative price, end time before start time) and verify validation errors are shown.

features.title: Cancel auction
features.user_visible_behavior: A seller can cancel their own auction before it ends; bidders can no longer bid on it.
verification: Log in as the seller of an active auction and click Cancel.
Verify the auction status changes to 'cancelled'.
Log in as a bidder and verify a bid on the cancelled auction is rejected.
Verify any held bidder credit is released.
Log in as a non-owner and verify they cannot cancel the auction.
features.notes: Define rule for whether cancellation is allowed after bids exist.

features.title: Manage your auctions
features.user_visible_behavior: A customer can see the list of auctions they created, with status (upcoming, active, ended, cancelled), current highest bid, and can open each one.
verification: Log in as a customer who has created auctions in different states.
Open 'My Auctions'.
Verify only this customer's auctions are listed with correct status and current highest bid.
Open an auction and verify its details and bid history are shown.

features.title: Make a bid
features.user_visible_behavior: A bidder can place a bid on an active auction that is higher than the current highest bid by at least the minimum increment.
verification: Log in as a bidder and open an active auction owned by someone else.
Place a valid bid and verify it becomes the current highest bid.
Place a bid lower than or equal to the current highest bid and verify it is rejected.
Place a bid exceeding available credit and verify it is rejected.
Verify the seller cannot bid on their own auction.
Verify bids on ended or cancelled auctions are rejected.

features.title: Post a message
features.user_visible_behavior: A bidder can post a message on an auction page and it is visible to other users viewing that auction.
verification: Log in as a bidder and open an auction.
Post a message and verify it appears in the auction's message list with author and time.
Log in as another customer and verify the message is visible.
Submit an empty message and verify it is rejected.
features.notes: Clarify whether messages go to the auction thread (public) or directly to the seller.

features.title: Manage your biddings
features.user_visible_behavior: A customer can see all auctions they have bid on, their latest bid, whether they are currently winning/outbid, and the auction outcome.
verification: Log in as a customer who has bid on several auctions.
Open 'My Biddings'.
Verify each auction shows the customer's latest bid and current highest bid.
Verify status is correct (winning, outbid, won, lost, cancelled).
Verify only this customer's bids are listed.

features.title: View available and just complete auction
features.user_visible_behavior: A customer can see all auctions, just completed auctions, available auctions, remaining counted down
verification: Open homepage not log in, or reg
Check all auctions appear on homepage
Verify each auction shows time available, just completed auctions only show(not accpet new bid) , remaining time of auctions
Only logged in user can bid

features.title: Search available and just complete auction by seller, auctions, category, products
features.user_visible_behavior: A customer can search all auctions, just completed auctions, available auctions
verification: Toggle search-tools
Verify search input field by seller-name, auctions, category, products
Verify result should match keywords input
